system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: All agents in UniDebugger share a one-shot structure of the system prompt, which defines their roles, skills, actions, objectives, and constraints, followed by a manually crafted example
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent role template plus bug metadata.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: RepoFocus provides a list of bug-related code files that need further examination by analyzing the bug metadata and the file structure of the program.
env_context_strategy.note: File-structure analysis + summarizer/slicer context injection + RAG search engine (Helper).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: On L3, Summarizer runs once on every bug-related file identified by RepoFocus. The other agents do not need to read every code line in the program while still knowing the core contents through these summaries.

observation_format.evidence_quote: all agents have access to certain meta-information known as bug metadata, including the bug-located code file, failing test cases, reported errors during compilation and testing

tool_count.note: Toolbox contains static analysis, dynamic analysis, and search engine, but no explicit tool schema count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Fixer is prompted to generate a "diff"
edit_primitive.note: Diff applied by rule-based context matching rather than patch(1).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: followed by a manually crafted example to illustrate the desired response format

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The toolbox of UniDebugger currently contains static analysis tools, dynamic analysis tools, and a search engine optimized for LLMs and RAG.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Afterward, we compile and run tests on the fixed program.
loop_primitives.note: Three-level fixed workflows; maximum 20 attempts per bug.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: we define three workflows for the three levels of repair, respectively
planning_granularity.note: Workflow is hard-coded; no plan object maintained by agents.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we uniquely structure UniDebugger as a hierarchical multi-agent coordination paradigm grounded in cognitive debugging theory

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Locator, Fixer, and FixerPro work in sequence based on the suspicious segment, and all have access to the code summary.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The patch will be sent to developers for manual correctness verification if passing all test cases.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the results of tool invocations will be stored for the requests of downstream agents to avoid duplicated invocations

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: we alter the default web search engine (Tavily Tavily) to a local one during evaluation to prevent retrieving ground-truth solutions online
long_term_memory.note: RAG over an external solution corpus is retrieval, not cross-run memory; no persisted agent memory described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Afterward, we compile and run tests on the fixed program.
self_verification.note: FixerPro reviews Fixer's patch (self-critique); SonarQube static analysis provides errors and warnings.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The maximum number of attempts is set to 5 per bug for Lite and 20 for Full.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If no plausible patch is produced, UniDebugger will display the analysis report written by FixerPro and take another run until reaching a resource threshold.
termination_condition.note: Run ends when a plausible (all tests passing) patch is found, or at the attempt cap.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: take another run until reaching a resource threshold
cost_controls.note: Expense per bug reported in ablation; threshold on resources.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Each query has a timeout limit of 1 sec.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Helper generates a short query and invokes an external search engine to retrieve the best-matching solutions.

permission_model.evidence_quote: agents can adaptively invoke tools in a given toolbox
permission_model.note: No authorisation mechanism described; tool set is fixed.

tracing.evidence_quote: UniDebugger will display the analysis report written by FixerPro

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: We evaluate UniDebugger on four benchmarks featuring bug-fix pairs, including competition programs
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark evaluation reported; harness-side runner not verified in repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: ensuring the final output is directly sliced from the original code to prevent code tampering caused by LLM hallucinations

target_domain.evidence_quote: the first end-to-end framework, UniDebugger, for unified debugging through multi-agent synergy

open_source.evidence_quote: Our source code is available on an anonymous link: https://github.com/BEbillionaireUSD/UniDebugger

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We apply UniDebugger to seven LLMs, including four general-purpose models

pinned_version.note: No repo commit pinned; coded from paper v3.
